claim: What does the 3.7% decline in AI-exposed young-worker jobs prove?
sourceFinding: ADP reported a September 2026 year-over-year 3.7% employment decline for US ages 22–25 in highly AI-exposed occupations, versus a 0.2% increase in least-exposed jobs.
evidenceLimits: Observational payroll trends do not prove AI caused the decline; exposure differs from measured displacement.
nextEvidenceTrigger: Later payroll releases and research separating AI adoption from other labor-market drivers.
sourceTimeline: 2026-10-21: ADP publishes the September payroll comparison
integrityRule: Append-only revisions: never overwrite this snapshot. Future evidence changes require a new version and review.
